description: This PHP class OAuthService provides functionalities for managing OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to get OAuth client DAO, update and retrieve mobile client status, and obtain mobile client ID, encapsulating operations related to OAuth client configuration.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: Service class for managing OAuth clients, specifically handling mobile client status within the OAuth system.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDao
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of OAuthClientDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: updateMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the mobile OAuth client by updating its status in the database.

methods.name: getMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the mobile OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: getMobileClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the mobile OAuth client if it exists.
